lesson: A single 2D vector: identity → reference angle → orthogonal decomposition → reconstruction

stages.title: 01: Original vector and reference direction
stages.question: What is the input vector and which axis is used?
stages.evidence: Full input arrow and original unit reference direction are visible

stages.title: 02: Definition of an angle
stages.question: Which two rays form theta?
stages.evidence: Common origin, input ray and reference-axis ray, measured arc in XY

stages.title: 03: Decomposition
stages.question: How is the input reconstructed from parallel and perpendicular components?
stages.evidence: Projection foot and two closed triangle legs; original arrow remains

stages.title: 04: Reconstruction and edge cases
stages.question: What changes under zero or negative angle?
stages.evidence: Both components are retained alongside the original; sum closes triangle
